title: Trash-Talking Woman Gets Humbled By Cops
description:
On what should’ve been a rather normal night, Florida Officers responded to a gas station in reference to a physical altercation between two females. The women were reportedly married to each other and one of them was hitting and kicking the other in her face. The officers were surprised at the way the female was acting so erratically and even her wife was visibly traumatised by her actions. Let's see if she learns to act better before things get any worse. Seemingly left without a choice, there was only one way for the officers to go forward. The female was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
